That sounded lame, so he tried again. “It’s a talking doll.”}}<div class="wv-epigraph-cite">{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|— ''House of Blades'', chapter 18}}</div></div>
''See also: [[Otoku Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Otoku is a character associated with the house in [[Bel Calem]], where she maintains that individuals must earn everything they desire. She is depicted as a doll with black hair and a red silk dress, though she has at times appeared with half of her face torn away, leaving only lifeless wood. Otoku possesses a voice that can range from breezy and drifting to harsh and cold, and she is capable of expressing various emotions including sarcasm, desperation, and self-satisfaction. Throughout her interactions, she provides guidance, commands, and commentary on the actions of others, such as [[Kai]] and [[Simon]]. She has been known to be quite demanding and can become displeased if forgotten, yet her presence can also feel as warm as sunlight.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Otoku is a doll of a little girl featuring long, black hair and a dress patterned with red flowers. Her face was once crushed and torn away, leaving half of it shattered.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|This character communicates with tones of self-satisfaction and is prone to using sarcasm or jokes. Otoku is known to mock [[Kai]] and provides commentary regarding victory, defeat, and the learning process.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Otoku shares a connection with [[Kai]], whom she mocks and who seeks to protect and avenge her. She also communicates with [[Simon]] by providing him with combat instructions and warnings. Additionally, Azura has sensed an image of the doll with her face partially torn away.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Otoku is a talking doll capable of movement and communication through a hazy mental voice heard within [[Simon]]'s mind. She provides combat instructions, offers warnings, and can alert [[Kai]] to incoming strikes.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|House of Blades}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-01-house-of-blades|Otoku is a doll of a little girl characterized by long black hair and a red flower patterned dress.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c5">''House of Blades'', chapter 5</ref> Known by the name [[Kai]] addresses, this doll is a being that can communicate through a hazy mental voice while being cradled by [[Kai]].<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c7">''House of Blades'', chapter 7</ref><ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c11">''House of Blades'', chapter 11</ref> [[Simon]] carries the talking doll attached to his belt, where she maintains communication with him.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c18">''House of Blades'', chapter 18</ref> During their travels, Otoku claims that [[the Nye]] never leave their home and provides [[Simon]] with both warnings and combat instructions.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c18" /><ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c19">''House of Blades'', chapter 19</ref> She also offers commentary regarding the nature of victory and defeat.<ref name="tg-01-house-of-blades-c21">''House of Blades'', chapter 21</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-02-crimson-vault|The Crimson Vault}} ===

=== {{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|City of Light}} ===
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|Otoku is a long, black-haired character who lies in [[Kai]]'s lap and speaks with tones of self-satisfaction.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c6">''City of Light'', chapter 6</ref> While [[Simon]] once considered asking her for something, she later responds to [[Kai]]'s voice with a windy sigh and offers comments regarding [[Simon]]'s learning.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c8">''City of Light'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c14">''City of Light'', chapter 14</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c16">''City of Light'', chapter 16</ref> Tragedy struck when Otoku's face was crushed and torn away, leaving her with half of her face shattered.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c21">''City of Light'', chapter 21</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c24">''City of Light'', chapter 24</ref> Following this, [[Kai]] desired to protect her and eventually sought to avenge her death.<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c22">''City of Light'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c27">''City of Light'', chapter 27</ref> Azura sensed an image of Otoku with half her face torn away, and the character's name now rests on the same headstone as [[Kai]].<ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c22" /><ref name="tg-03-city-of-light-c25">''City of Light'', chapter 25</ref>}}
